purpose: Single user-facing Home Screen app pointer. The Home Screen icon points to pmp-app-current.html; this map decides which runtime file is currently loaded.

current_app.label: PMP Current
current_app.reason: Flatten current runtime so support scripts attach closer to the visible app layer. This should make Copy Lossless Report and Resident diagnostics more reliable. User-facing version remains PMP Current.

user_facing_rule: Only show PMP Current / PMP-CURRENT-1 as the app version. Do not ask the user to install numbered app files.
update_rule: Future updates should update this map or pmp-app-current.html. The Home Screen app remains pmp-app-current.html.
home_screen_rule: Install pmp-app-current.html once. Do not install individual version files again unless recovering from a broken current shell.
internal_file_rule: Numbered files are internal implementation/archive files, not the public app version. pmp-current-runtime.html is the flattened internal runtime, not a user-facing version.
